```{r}
library('ggplot2')
library('dplyr')
data <- read.table("BirthWeights.txt", sep = " ", header = TRUE, as.is = FALSE)
```

# 1. 

```{r}
lm <- lm(BirthWeight ~ Mage, data = data)

plot(data$Mage, data$BirthWeight)
abline(lm, col="blue", lwd=2)
```


# 2. 

```{r}
boxplot(BirthWeight ~ Race, data = data)
```


# 3. 

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Gage, y = BirthWeight, color = Race)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +              # Plot scatter points with slight transparency
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) # Add linear model lines without standard error shading
```

# 4. 

```{r}
data %>%
  group_by(Gen) %>%
  summarise(correlation = cor(BirthWeight, Mage))
```


# 5. 

```{r}
GGally::ggpairs(data)
```
